backend.trusted_audit: Direct member INSERT revoked; SECURITY DEFINER accepts rate-limited CLIENT_ACTIVITY with actor_role CLIENT_REPORTED and outcome UNVERIFIED_CLIENT_EVENT.

backend.document_signing: Requires provisioned profile, exact typed name, authentic SHA-256 document digest and owner/issuer authorization; writes server-backed signature with audit entry.
backend.member_directory: Excludes unprovisioned JWT identities at SECURITY DEFINER function boundary.
